The elevations use color/pattern swatches corresponding to the legend to indicate where each material is applied on the building facades.

The material legend explicitly identifies six different exterior finishes. These elevations allow compatibility review of building appearance, materials, and massing relative to adjacent residential uses. The described deficiency does NOT exist—building elevations with architectural elements ARE provided.
findings.explanation: Sheets 35 and 36 provide building elevations for all four facades (North, East, South, West) showing architectural elements (materials, fenestration, balconies, rooflines, massing) with material legends.

findings.observation: Reviewed Sheet 14 (Dimensional Control & Site Plan 1 Of 2) using vision tool and blocks.md analysis. The site plan shows compatibility setback lines along the western property boundary (adjacent to SF-3 zoned single-family properties) with multiple setback distances: 10', 25', 50', and 75' marked on the plan. Sheet 14 also includes a 'Compatibility Setback Lines' table specifying allowable building heights at each distance: 0'-10' (unmarked), 10'-25' (0' screening zone), 25'-50' (0' restricted zone), 50'-75' (40' height limit). Similar setback lines are shown near the southern boundary adjacent to another SF-3 property. The vision tool confirmed a 75' building setback line is clearly marked along the western boundary.
findings.reasoning: The checklist item describes a deficiency: 'Setbacks adjacent to residential uses or zoning not shown on plans.' Sheet 14 explicitly shows compatibility setback lines (10', 25', 50', 75') adjacent to the SF-3 (single-family residential) zoned properties to the west and includes a table defining height restrictions within each setback zone. These setbacks are required under LDC Article 10 Compatibility Standards when a site is adjacent to triggering properties (SF-5 or more restrictive with 1-3 units). The site plan demonstrates compliance awareness by depicting these setback lines relative to the proposed building footprint. The described deficiency does NOT exist—setbacks adjacent to residential zoning ARE shown on the plans.
findings.explanation: Sheet 14 shows compatibility setback lines (10', 25', 50', 75') adjacent to SF-3 residential zoning on the west, with a table defining allowable heights in each zone.

summary: All 3 checklist items pass. Site is subject to Compatibility Standards; all required compatibility documentation is provided on the plans.
